styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium kitchen cutlery ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte charcoal black #1A1A1A, soft light grey #F4F4F2, warm stone grey #9C9C98, with one sharp red accent #D43425; neutral temperature; modern geometric sans-serif type with small red underline accents; alternating dark slate-texture and light grey-white backgrounds; dramatic left-front key light with soft fill and controlled rim light on dark scenes, bright even high-key light on light scenes; matte black surfaces with subtle texture, thin-line red circle icons for infographic elements; knives always presented seated or aligned with stable centered placement and soft contact shadow; every screen finished as one complete balanced composition with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源文件夹名为「百货」，以图为准判断为家居日用-厨房用品下的不锈钢厨房刀具六件套（含黑色喷漆刀座、剪刀），与库内紫外消毒刀架模版（xiaodudaojia）为不同产品；已剥离源图红标签文案、红色手写体英文点缀、具体工艺数值（钢材牌号/硬度/开刃角度）、熔岩摄影图与二维码促销区，全部在图文案改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽位由使用方填写。
